_comment: Splash lines for the main menu, in the Minecraft tradition: one short
line beside the title, picked per launch.
DATA, NOT SOURCE, AND DELIBERATELY SO. A string literal in a .cpp gets
picked up by tools/i18n_extract.py and then wants translating into all
forty-four languages the game ships. Jokes are the worst possible thing to
put through that: they do not survive translation, a translator has no way
to know which are jokes, and every one added later would block a release
on translation work. Here they are English, they are optional, and a
translator who WANTS to localise them can ship their own file.
Keep them short: this is drawn beside the title and shrinks with it.
occasions: from/to are MM-DD inclusive and may wrap the year (see the new
year entry). 'fall' names the particle the menu rains on those days.
'lines' are used INSTEAD of the everyday ones while the window is open.
